statements.proposition: This change adds error handling in apps/web/src/instrumentation.ts that catches initialization failures instead of letting them crash the app
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: File modified; the register() body is now wrapped in try/catch that logs the error and deliberately does not rethrow. The 'prevent app crashes' purpose is the stated intent in the code comment; whether it prevents all crashes is not tested.
evidence: patch: try { ... await EmailQueueService.init() ... } catch (error) { console.error('Failed to initialize services during instrumentation:', error); // Don't throw here ... }

statements.proposition: This change is backward compatible with existing configurations
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: No concrete check settles it. Config/env names are unchanged (no new required env var seen), but behaviour changes: initializeQueue became async and can reject (callers in ses-settings-service now await it), Redis is created with lazyConnect/enableReadyCheck:false, and startup now swallows init errors. Whether these break existing deployments cannot be established from the diff alone.
evidence: gh api pulls/232/files: 4 files modified (instrumentation.ts, redis.ts, email-queue-service.ts, ses-settings-service.ts)
patch email-queue-service.ts: 'public static initializeQueue' -> 'public static async initializeQueue'; ses-settings-service.ts both call sites changed to await
